    13  # Additive Contents
    14  
    15  An additive content `m` on a set of sets `C` is a set function with value 0 at the empty set which
    16  is finitely additive on `C`. That means that for any finset `I` of pairwise disjoint sets in `C`
    17  such that `⋃₀ I ∈ C`, `m (⋃₀ I) = ∑ s ∈ I, m s`.
    18  
    19  Mathlib also has a definition of contents over compact sets: see `MeasureTheory.Content`.
    20  A `Content` is in particular an `AddContent` on the set of compact sets.
    21  
    22  ## Main definitions
    23  
    24  * `MeasureTheory.AddContent G C`: additive contents over the set of sets `C` taking values in the
    25    additive monoid `G`.
    26  * `MeasureTheory.AddContent.IsSigmaSubadditive`: an `AddContent` with values in `ℝ≥0∞` is
    27    σ-subadditive if `m (⋃ i, f i) ≤ ∑' i, m (f i)` for any sequence of sets `f` in `C`
    28    such that `⋃ i, f i ∈ C`.
    29  
    30  ## Main statements
    31  
    32  Let `m` be an `AddContent C` with values in `ℝ≥0∞`. If `C` is a set semi-ring (`IsSetSemiring C`)
    33  we have the properties
    34  
    35  * `MeasureTheory.sum_addContent_le_of_subset`: if `I` is a finset of pairwise disjoint sets in `C`
    36    and `⋃₀ I ⊆ t` for `t ∈ C`, then `∑ s ∈ I, m s ≤ m t`.
    37  * `MeasureTheory.addContent_mono`: if `s ⊆ t` for two sets in `C`, then `m s ≤ m t`.
    38  * `MeasureTheory.addContent_sUnion_le_sum`: an `AddContent C` on a `SetSemiring C` is
    39    sub-additive.
    40  * `MeasureTheory.addContent_iUnion_eq_tsum_of_disjoint_of_addContent_iUnion_le`: if an
    41    `AddContent` is σ-subadditive on a semi-ring of sets, then it is σ-additive.
    42  * `MeasureTheory.addContent_union'`: if `s, t ∈ C` are disjoint and `s ∪ t ∈ C`,
    43    then `m (s ∪ t) = m s + m t`.
    44    If `C` is a set ring (`IsSetRing`), then `addContent_union` gives the same conclusion without the
    45    hypothesis `s ∪ t ∈ C` (since it is a consequence of `IsSetRing C`).
    46

    48  
    49  * `MeasureTheory.addContent_union_le`: for `s, t ∈ C`, `m (s ∪ t) ≤ m s + m t`

    58  We define a specific example of `AddContent`, called `AddContent.onIoc`, on the semiring of sets
    59  made of open-closed intervals, mapping `(a, b]` to `f b - f a`.

    13  # Additive Contents
    14  
    15  An additive content `m` on a set of sets `C` is a set function with value 0 at the empty set which
    16  is finitely additive on `C`. That means that for any finset `I` of pairwise disjoint sets in `C`
    17  such that `⋃₀ I ∈ C`, `m (⋃₀ I) = ∑ s ∈ I, m s`.
    18  
    19  Mathlib also has a definition of contents over compact sets: see `MeasureTheory.Content`.
    20  A `Content` is in particular an `AddContent` on the set of compact sets.
    21  
    22  ## Main definitions
    23  
    24  * `MeasureTheory.AddContent G C`: additive contents over the set of sets `C` taking values in the
    25    additive monoid `G`.
    26  * `MeasureTheory.AddContent.IsSigmaSubadditive`: an `AddContent` with values in `ℝ≥0∞` is
    27    σ-subadditive if `m (⋃ i, f i) ≤ ∑' i, m (f i)` for any sequence of sets `f` in `C`
    28    such that `⋃ i, f i ∈ C`.
    29  
    30  ## Main statements
    31  
    32  Let `m` be an `AddContent C` with values in `ℝ≥0∞`. If `C` is a set semi-ring (`IsSetSemiring C`)
    33  we have the properties
    34  
    35  * `MeasureTheory.sum_addContent_le_of_subset`: if `I` is a finset of pairwise disjoint sets in `C`
    36    and `⋃₀ I ⊆ t` for `t ∈ C`, then `∑ s ∈ I, m s ≤ m t`.
    37  * `MeasureTheory.addContent_mono`: if `s ⊆ t` for two sets in `C`, then `m s ≤ m t`.
    38  * `MeasureTheory.addContent_sUnion_le_sum`: an `AddContent C` on a `SetSemiring C` is
    39    sub-additive.
    40  * `MeasureTheory.addContent_iUnion_eq_tsum_of_disjoint_of_addContent_iUnion_le`: if an
    41    `AddContent` is σ-subadditive on a semi-ring of sets, then it is σ-additive.
    42  * `MeasureTheory.addContent_union'`: if `s, t ∈ C` are disjoint and `s ∪ t ∈ C`,
    43    then `m (s ∪ t) = m s + m t`.
    44    If `C` is a set ring (`IsSetRing`), then `addContent_union` gives the same conclusion without the
    45    hypothesis `s ∪ t ∈ C` (since it is a consequence of `IsSetRing C`).
    46

    48  
    49  * `MeasureTheory.addContent_union_le`: for `s, t ∈ C`, `m (s ∪ t) ≤ m s + m t`
